steps.title: Wash and Pre-incubate Islets
steps.instruction: Wash and pre-incubate mouse islets in low glucose KRBH to stabilize them.

substeps.instruction: Pick islets into a 35mm non-tissue cultured coated (NTCC) dish and wash with 2 mL of low glucose (2.8mM) KRBH.
Transfer islets into a new 35mm NTCC dish with 2 mL of low glucose (2.8mM) KRBH.
Pre-incubate for 1 hour at 37 °C and 5% CO2.

steps.title: Distribute Islets into Treatment Groups
steps.instruction: Allocate islets into eppendorf tubes for experimental groups, performing each treatment in triplicate.

substeps.instruction: Pick 15 islets into each eppendorf tube (adjust number based on ELISA kit sensitivity).
Establish control groups using 2.8mM glucose (low) and 16.7mM glucose (high).

steps.title: Perform Low Glucose Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate islets in low glucose KRBH and collect the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Gently add 500 µL of low glucose KRBH to the islets.
Incubate for 1 hour at 37 °C and 5% CO2 with tube lids open.
Close lids, gently invert tubes, and centrifuge at 1000 rpm for 1 minute to pellet islets.
Collect as much of the 500 µL supernatant as possible without disturbing the pellet and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Perform High Glucose Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate islets in high glucose KRBH and collect the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Gently add 500 µL of high glucose (16.7mM) KRBH to the islets.
Incubate for 1 hour at 37 °C and 5% CO2 with tube lids open.
Close lids, gently invert tubes, and centrifuge at 1000 rpm for 1 minute to pellet islets.
Collect as much of the 500 µL supernatant as possible without disturbing the pellet and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Extract Insulin Content
steps.instruction: Extract total insulin content from the islets using acid ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of acid ethanol to the islets.
Store the tube at -20 °C until the insulin assay.

steps.title: Culture Islets for Purity
steps.instruction: Culture mouse islets to ensure maximum purity.

substeps.instruction: Pick mouse islets into Mouse Islet Culture Media until as close as possible to 100% purity.
Culture islets overnight in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.

steps.title: Perform Insulin Assay
steps.instruction: Analyze insulin levels using the specified ELISA kit.

substeps.instruction: Use the ALPCO Stellux Rodent Insulin ELISA kit (Cat # 80-INSMR-CH10).
Dilute content samples with zero buffer at a ratio of 1:400.
